title: Double Taxation Treaty Passport Scheme register
text:
This register shows details of companies registered for the Double Taxation Treaty Passport Scheme .

 You can use it to help verify a passport holder’s status if you’re a borrower.

 HMRC regularly adds new lenders to these lists.
changeNote: The register has been updated with 446 additions, 28 amendments and 219 removals.
